title: workflow-hardening run-key reader: drop the key-column arm and measure GitHub's acceptance of the edge layouts (OMARK-106 r5 nits 1-2)
description: From the round-5 review of #243 (approved with nits). (1) DELETE the key-column arm in runText (scripts/test/workflow-hardening.test.mjs, the `indentOf(L[k]) === keyCol` clause), so the quoted / spaced-colon / multi-space-dash spellings of run are read on the step dash line only. (2) MEASURE against GitHub itself whether a workflow file is accepted with (a) a duplicate quoted-plus-unquoted run key in one step and (b) a flow-mapping or quoted continuation at the key column; add rejecting fixtures accordingly. If GitHub accepts either, priority high; otherwise it waits for the morning plan. Measuring needs a probe workflow pushed to a repository GitHub parses, which is an outward-facing act: the leader to confirm where. Floor tier: Sonnet writer, Opus review (CI gate policy).

acceptanceCriteria.text: the key-column arm is deleted and the suite proves the new spellings are read on the dash line only, both ways
GitHub acceptance of (a) a duplicate quoted-plus-unquoted run key and (b) a flow-mapping or quoted continuation at the key column is measured and the result recorded
a fixture exists for each layout GitHub accepts

implementationNotes: Leader ruling 2026-11-17: no live probe from this public repository, and no new scratch repository. The GitHub-parser measurement needs a decision on WHERE (an existing private sandbox, or no live probe at all); that goes to the morning plan. The key-column arm deletion is safe to do without the measurement.
